purpose: Candidate gold-standard multi-label requirements for evaluating the Day 5 zero-shot and few-shot classification baselines. NOT verified truth yet -- every entry needs a human pass before use.
instructions_for_reviewers: For each requirement, confirm the 'categories' list is correct and complete against the 13-category taxonomy below. Add/remove labels as needed.
Flip 'verified' to true only after a human has checked it.
Entries sourced from day4_extraction_baseline.json had their category_hint tightened/expanded to the exact taxonomy strings -- double-check these especially, since hints were free text.

Once verified, freeze this file as the Day 5 / Month 4 held-out eval set. Do NOT fold it into the Day 7 training corpus (200+ examples) -- keep it separate so fine-tuned-vs-baseline comparisons stay valid.
If you trim to a smaller set for speed, keep at least 2-3 examples per category so per-category F1 isn't computed on n=1.

requirements.statement: The system shall provide a mobile-responsive online loan application portal accessible on both Android and iOS browsers.
The system shall verify applicant identity through Aadhaar-based eKYC before allowing submission of a loan application.
requirements.reviewer_notes: Added Privacy beyond original hint (Functional, Regulatory, Security) since Aadhaar handling implies personal-data concerns. Confirm.

requirements.statement: The system shall fetch applicant credit scores from CIBIL in real-time and return the result within 3 seconds.
requirements.reviewer_notes: Added Performance -- the '3 seconds' target was not in the original statement, I inferred it as an example of a testable performance clause. Adjust or remove if not accurate.

requirements.statement: The system shall route loan applications exceeding ₹50 lakhs to a senior loan officer for manual approval.
requirements.reviewer_notes: Added Stakeholder since 'senior loan officer' is a named actor/role. Confirm this counts under your Stakeholder definition.

requirements.statement: The system shall handle all applicant data in compliance with RBI's Digital Lending Guidelines, including data localization requirements.
requirements.reviewer_notes: Added Privacy beyond original hint (Regulatory, Data-management). Confirm.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow a loan applicant to save an in-progress application and resume it within 30 days.
The system shall calculate the applicant's debt-to-income ratio using declared income and existing CIBIL liabilities to determine loan eligibility.
The system shall encrypt all applicant PII, including PAN and Aadhaar numbers, at rest using AES-256 encryption.
The system shall retain loan application and supporting KYC documents for a minimum of 8 years in accordance with RBI record-retention norms.
The system shall notify the applicant via SMS and email at each stage of the loan approval workflow: submitted, under review, approved, disbursed.
The system shall generate a monthly compliance report listing all loan applications that required manual override of automated approval rules.
The loan origination service shall maintain 99.9% uptime during business hours, 9 AM to 6 PM IST, excluding scheduled maintenance windows.
The system shall alert the operations on-call team if the CIBIL API integration fails for more than five consecutive requests.
The system shall support at least 500 concurrent loan application submissions without response times exceeding 5 seconds.
The system shall allow the credit risk team to configure and update loan eligibility scoring thresholds without requiring a code deployment.
The system shall capture a live selfie and match it against the Aadhaar photograph using facial recognition during customer onboarding.
The system shall mask the customer's Aadhaar number, showing only the last 4 digits, on all screens except during the verification step.
The system shall onboard a new customer end-to-end, from document upload to account activation, within 10 minutes on average.
The system shall allow the compliance team to review and approve or reject customer onboarding cases flagged for manual KYC review.
The system shall log every access to a customer's KYC documents, including the user ID, timestamp, and reason for access.
The onboarding portal shall be usable by first-time digital banking users with no prior training, following WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility guidelines.
The system shall integrate with the UIDAI Aadhaar authentication API to perform real-time identity verification.
The system shall automatically purge onboarding documents for rejected applications after 90 days unless legally required to retain them.
The onboarding service shall be available 24/7 with a maximum planned downtime of 4 hours per month for maintenance.
The system shall support onboarding volumes of up to 10,000 new customers per day during festive-season promotional campaigns.
The system shall process a UPI payment request and confirm success or failure to the payer within 5 seconds.
The system shall route failed payment transactions to a reconciliation queue for the operations team to investigate within 24 hours.
The system shall maintain an immutable audit trail of every payment transaction, including amount, timestamp, and both parties' account references.
The payments gateway shall encrypt all transaction data in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher.
The system shall integrate with the NPCI UPI switch to process real-time interbank fund transfers.
The finance team shall be able to generate a daily settlement report reconciling all processed payment transactions against the core banking ledger.
The payments platform shall maintain 99.95% availability, given its role as a critical real-time financial service.
